narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>I think multiplying w minus three by three gives three w minus three. The three multiplies only w.
<bookmark mark='s1'/>The three multiplies every term inside the bracket.
<bookmark mark='s3'/>Then w minus three is two, and three times two is six.
<bookmark mark='s4'/>But three w minus three gives twelve, which is wrong.
